{{Quote|You have completed the first stages of your training and I am sending you on an assignment to Toydaria. You will bring me King Katuunko…alive. Kill all who might interfere.|Count Dooku, to Savage Opress|<ref name="WOTM" />}}
A '''showdown''' occurred on the [[planet]] [[Toydaria]] between [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s new [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] [[Savage Opress]]. Another duel occurred in orbit between Dooku, Opress and the [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Asajj Ventress]], and later, another duel between Opress, Kenobi and Skywalker. In addition, Ventress and Dooku also had another brief skirmish.<ref name="WOTM" />

Opress, under orders from his new master, went to Toydaria in order to kidnap [[King]] [[Katuunko]] alive. Unfortunately for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the mission was in shambles when Opress killed Katuunko in a rage and presented the body to Dooku, causing the Dark Lord to get very angry and punish him severely much to his distress.<ref name="WOTM" />

The confrontation continued over Toydaria aboard Dooku's [[Dooku's Providence-class carrier/destroyer|Separatist dreadnought]], where Dooku's former apprentice, Ventress, attempted to exact revenge on her old Master for betraying her during the [[Battle of Sullust]] with the help of Opress, who was under her control. However, Opress turned on both Dooku and Ventress (due to being repeatedly insulted by them), and while Ventress pursued Dooku, Opress dueled with Kenobi and Skywalker, who had arrived to eliminate him.<ref name="WOTM" />

The showdown ended when both Ventress and Opress escaped their pursuers alive, while the Jedi also fled from the cruiser. Opress returned to [[Dathomir]] and was instructed by [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]] to find his brother [[Maul|Darth Maul]].<ref name="WOTM" /> Dooku would come to order an [[Battle of Dathomir|attack]] on Dathomir.<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>
